semantics: Native dispatch and control use CLOCK_MONOTONIC microseconds. MAKCU delivery uses elapsedRealtimeNanos / 1000; Bluetooth uses System.nanoTime / 1000. Map clocks with runtime_clock_anchor. Zero stage timestamp means not reached or unavailable. ACK is not measured physical motion. Camera background includes manual input and scene motion; WSAD and player intention are not observed. Ranked alternative is diagnostic, not the selected switch candidate. Legacy rows have schema_version < 6 and unknown added fields padded with zero.

coordinate_semantics: Read trace_coordinate_space plus coordinate_width/height. Neural input is 640, physical capture and control coordinates are 1024. Native bridge scales all boxes, background and image correspondence consistently before control. Historical rows without coordinate_width use their model dimensions (legacy 416). Mouse calibration is physical screen pixels per HID count.
host_frame_v2_notes: First 22 fields unchanged from v1. Six appended durations split successful MF frames into GPU copy+Map, CPU BGRA-to-NV12 conversion, input allocation/copy, ProcessInput/event wait, output allocation/ProcessOutput/event wait, and output normalization/copy. Zeros for other backends or failed frames mean not measured.
host_frame_v3_notes: v2 fields plus anonymous Windows foreground PID, for distinguishing game foreground from background/menu capture. MF color conversion includes CPU bilinear resize when the encoder-selected event says CPU bilinear 1024-to-640.

duration_prefixes.native_submit_first_mutex_wait: Wait for decoder mutex before enqueue validation
duration_prefixes.native_submit_second_mutex_wait: Wait for decoder mutex after Java offer returns

pipeline_backpressure_metrics.semantics: TTL stays50ms and capacity4AU. Complete means all fragments arrived but prior missing/expired AU may still block delivery. Legacy incomplete_losses includes both complete and partial discarded AUs; never equate it with missing UDP datagrams.

disturbance_selection_contract.sampling: Event-only per-axis evidence, not every Core observation. First context, branch/window-type/point-count or validity/limiting changes, and >100px/s selected-velocity changes while both target errors are within16 control pixels produce events; sliding timestamps alone do not. Missing event rows cannot prove stable motion.
disturbance_selection_contract.units: All35 fields are integers. Phone monotonic clocks are microseconds without float conversion; velocity/error milli divide by1000; response and quality e6 divide by1000000. Geometry matches control_trace_v6 control-ROI pixels (production1024 physical screen pixels), not640 model input pixels.
disturbance_selection_contract.validity: has_interval distinguishes absent/insufficient evidence from a measured zero interval. estimator_valid is separate from numeric zero. The actual recent-four or stationary control-point override returns its own selected evidence/window, not the superseded full-window branch.
disturbance_selection_contract.loss: Fixed256-row ring. disturbance_selection_trace_lost is the interval count overwritten since the preceding drain; reset is explicit. Event distributions are conditional on emitted and retained events, not all frames. Loss and missing Core contexts stay explicit.
disturbance_selection_contract.join: Join by control_trace_id and require sequence/observed/processed/wire/lock/track identity to match exactly; row-id reuse after reset is not interchangeable. Numeric comparisons with legacy v6 defaultfloat precision6 allow half its last significant decimal place at the reported magnitude plus half a new-field quantization unit (0.0005 for milli, 0.0000005 for e6). Target-error comparison uses the rounded target coordinate's magnitude before subtracting the known center. Missing asynchronous snapshot data is reported as unverified. Duplicate conflicting Core contexts and differences beyond those serialization bounds are not favorably selected.
disturbance_selection_contract.output: selected_velocity is the internal Core feedforward selection in pixels/second, not emitted HID counts, dispatch, hardware acceptance or physical execution. Same-context control dx/dy are only planned deltas; use dispatch/delivery evidence separately.

modes.1: shadow, legacy control consumes original A; added shadow work can affect following NNP throughput

projection_contract.clock: phone monotonic microseconds, integer; A remains actual neural source, B independently acquired newer pixels, control is actual Core-consumed observation, L its predecessor
projection_contract.geometry: MODEL pixels at 640x640, not physical 1024 control space; milli=divide by1000, e6=divide by1000000; -1 comparison/geometry sentinel is unavailable
projection_contract.accuracy: Comparison is a same-time NNP consistency proxy, not identity ground truth, head detection, hit rate or physical execution. Reliable comparison requires class equality, one-to-one matching and IoU>=0.50; all unscored and unmatched rows stay in denominators.
projection_contract.deadline: Original A decision deadline remains at most A observed+50000us; B never renews A. Core consumption and physical output completion are distinct.
projection_contract.analysis_active_contract: Outcome8 requires mode2, positive same-generation A/B identities, current NNP=A, B newer than A and L, complete nonempty source_count=valid_count<=16, ready gate/math, ordered math completion before original A cap, and a matching accepted Core sequence/wire/time before counting consumed-B gain. Missing Core or per-target log evidence is reported separately; explicit contradictory per-target evidence fails validation. Core observation is not physical execution.
projection_contract.analysis_denominators: Every complete math attempt is reconciled by generation/mode/A/B identity to exactly one compared or unscored terminal, or pending/invalid. Conditional agreement is reliable/compared source targets; comparison coverage is compared/all complete source targets; completed-source overall reliable fraction retains unscored, pending and invalid terminals. A second attempted-math denominator retains all source targets for which math_work_us>0, including failed, partial and budget-rejected attempts. Per-target missing rows and contradictory one-to-one matches remain explicit. These are detector consistency proxies.
projection_contract.analysis_cadence: Read consumed-B pixel age alongside accepted Core observation Hz, processing/pixel gaps, target-visible timing, old-source skips and complete/unscored/pending coverage. Core contexts include empty, held and tracking-only observations. The unchanged A-based pipeline capture-to-control field cannot be relabeled consumed-B pixel age.
